content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Presets stripe

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth. That means 149 countries are excluded from their services. And even in countries where they do operate, account suspensions can be devastating. A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. This is why you can't rely on those platforms for your business. You need a solution that's not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives you full control over your commerce operations. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is that solution.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need a GitHub account, a Google account, and a NOWPayments account. You'll also need to purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH's website. The Sovereign Starter Stack costs $97 and includes GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack costs $197 and includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Both stacks come with 30-day support.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've deployed your stack, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This pipeline will handle on-chain crypto payments and file delivery. You'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your stack and set up a payment handler. You'll also need to configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This will ensure that your customers receive their presets instantly.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that gives you full control over your commerce operations.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, you'll need to deploy your stack and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Once you're live, you can process your first transaction. This is where the magic happens. Your customers will be able to purchase your presets using their preferred cryptocurrency, and you'll receive the payment instantly. You'll also receive a webhook notification that confirms the payment.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, it's time to scale. This means adding more products, handling more traffic, and optimizing your pipeline. You can do this by purchasing additional templates and scaling playbooks from COREMERCH. You can also use the Sovereign Blueprint, which costs $47, to get complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and NOWPayments integration guide.
How to sell your own presets?

The most important question you're probably asking is: 'Will I be able to collect payments from my customers without relying on platforms like Stripe and PayPal?' The answer is yes. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure lets you collect payments directly from your customers using on-chain crypto payments. This means you'll have full control over your commerce operations and won't be held hostage by platform restrictions.
When you use COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll have access to complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and NOWPayments integration guide.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on how to sell presets without relying on platforms like Stripe and PayPal, you can check out related searches like 'How to sell presets without stripe reddit' or 'How to sell presets without stripe for lightroom'. You can also visit COREMERCH's website at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, or the Sovereign Blueprint.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH's website. Deploy your stack on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments with your stack. Configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Deploy your products and go live. Monitor your pipeline and optimize as needed. Purchase additional templates and scaling playbooks from COREMERCH to scale your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Will I need to purchase a separate payment gateway to process payments?
No, you won't need to purchase a separate payment gateway. NOWPayments is integrated directly into your stack, so you can process payments without relying on platforms like Stripe and PayPal.
Can I use any cryptocurrency to process payments?
Yes, you can use any cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, so you can choose the one that works best for your business.
How long does it take to deploy the infrastructure?
It takes 48 hours to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. This includes deploying your stack, configuring your payment and delivery pipeline, and going live.
Can I scale my infrastructure as needed?
Yes, you can scale your infrastructure as needed. You can purchase additional templates and scaling playbooks from COREMERCH to optimize your pipeline and handle more traffic.
Will I have access to support if I encounter issues?

Yes, you'll have access to 30-day support with the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack. This includes email support and help with deploying your stack and configuring your payment and delivery pipeline.
